description: Unit tests for context visibility evaluation functions, testing behavior of evaluateSupplementalContextVisibility, shouldIncludeSupplementalContext, and filterSupplementalContextItems.

methods.name: evaluateSupplementalContextVisibility
methods.description: Evaluates whether supplemental context should be included based on mode, kind, and sender permissions.

methods.name: shouldIncludeSupplementalContext
methods.description: Determines if a specific context item should be included based on mode, kind, and sender permission.

methods.name: filterSupplementalContextItems
methods.description: Filters context items based on sender allowance and mode, returning filtered items and omission count.
